title: Cancel h
text:
Cancel $h$ from numerator and denominator:

$$\frac{-h}{hx(x+h)} = \frac{-1}{x(x+h)}$$

Now we can take the limit.

title: Take the Limit
text:
Take the limit as $h \to 0$:

$$f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{-1}{x(x+h)}$$

As $h \to 0$, $(x+h) \to x$

title: Final Answer
text:
Substituting $h = 0$:

$$f'(x) = \frac{-1}{x \cdot x} = \frac{-1}{x^2} = -x^{-2}$$

Verification using the power rule:
$f(x) = x^{-1}$
$f'(x) = -1 \cdot x^{-2} = -\frac{1}{x^2}$ (Correct!)
